args.title: Treat inch marks in CSV descriptions as ordinary characters
args.body:
File: src/importers/csv.ts

Treat unescaped inch marks (double quotes) in the middle of unquoted CSV fields as ordinary characters rather than quote delimiters, preventing rows with inch marks in descriptions from failing column-count validation.
